definition: Every pinned A2 drug with exact Disease membership in approval.disease_ids and an approval.sources entry among FDA, EMA Human Drugs, PMDA or DailyMed; existing FDA overrides included.
limitations: Exact approval.disease_ids membership in the pinned A2 release; no name, symbol, ontology expansion or new label curation.
Approval sources are aggregated at drug level in A2. This export does not independently establish a regulator report for each drug-Disease pair or clinical indication truth.

The published protocol evaluates fixed blind panels. This separate full-universe shortlist comparison is descriptive retrospective source-record recovery, not a newly preregistered confirmatory analysis.
Both FDA overrides concern MONDO_0100096, outside the frozen 14 Diseases; they remain in the unchanged drug release and override_inventory, and add zero cohort reference pairs.
Warnings were not transformed or interpreted; missing warnings remain unknown.
